question: Who has been chosen as the national icon to raise awareness about voting and educate voters for the upcoming 2024 elections in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sachin Tendulkar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Sachin Tendulkar has been chosen as the national icon by the Election Commission of India to raise awareness about voting and educate voters for the upcoming 2024 elections.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This initiative aims to tackle urban and youth disinterest in the electoral process**.
 
• As part of a** three-year agreement he will engage in activities to enhance voter participation,** particularly among the youth​
 
• As a **highly respected and influential figure in Indian sports, Tendulkar is expected to use his popularity to encourage voter participation.**
 
• His involvement aims to bridge the gap between citizens and the electoral process, especially targeting disinterest among young voters​
 
• The Election Commission has signed a **three-year Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** with Tendulkar.
 
• This partnership indicates a long-term commitment to fostering voter awareness, not just for the upcoming elections but also for future electoral processes
 
• The initiative will specifically address challenges such as:
 
 
• Urban apathy towards voting.
 
• Youth disinterest in the electoral process.
 
• Educating citizens about their voting rights and responsibilities
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Election Commission has previously collaborated with various celebrities to promote voter awareness,
 
 
• including figures like **MS Dhoni**, **Aamir Khan**, and **Pankaj Tripathi**.
 
 
 
• This trend reflects an ongoing strategy to leverage the influence of popular personalities to inspire civic engagement
